followup_policy.evidence_source: Delegated read-only audit observed three snapshots in tool output/in memory; raw outputs were not retained. This is a sanitized reconstruction of category comparisons.
followup_policy.causality: A changed protected-prefix baseline is one health-check stop condition, but later hashes do not establish the timing or cause of this stop.

diagnostic_limits: The old UI attribution to the helper was stronger than FAILED_CLEAN proves; worker/IPC failures can yield that status too.
The helper stderr reason is not retained by the UI and the clean journal is cleared.
No application-coded active-session timer was found; that does not exclude an external signal or process/system event.
acceptance_effect: Personal voice/game success remains valid. Extended daily stability is not verified and this late stop is not labeled a stability pass.
